in_marathi.name: Hitendrasinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Hari with a lion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hitendrasinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hitendrasinh is a combination of 'Hite' and 'Endrasinh'. 'Hite' is an alternate name for Lord Vishnu, and 'Endrasinh' means 'Lord of the End'. The name suggests the protector and sustainer of the universe. It is a strong name for a boy born into a royal or powerful family.
